'''Coruscant''' is the 30th expansion of Star Wars CCG, published by Decipher in August 2001. It is 196 cards (98 Light Side / 95 Dark Side + 3): 60 rares, 60 uncommons, 60 commons, 9 alternate-image cards, 3 double-sided rules cards, and 4 checklists. Black border. CardGuide numbering: 30th product (CardGuide lists 189).

Sold in 11-card packs (MSRP $3.29: 1 rare or alternate image plus mixed commons/uncommons) in 30-pack boxes.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

== Print sheets ==
Rares, uncommons, and commons are 11&times;11 (121 cards). Commons and uncommons print on the same sheets. Each rare appears four times; for each alternate-image rare, 1 of those 4 is the AI version (except [[Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber]] Light and [[Dioxis]] Dark, five times each). Dark Side objectives print on the Light uncommon/common sheet.<ref name="encyc" />
